class Left { left = 1; }
class Right { right = 2; }
class Point { constructor(public x: number) {} }
class Scaled { constructor(public x: number, public scale = 2) {} }
class Generic<T> { constructor(public value: T) {} }

for (const flag of [true, false]) {
  const Constructor = flag ? Left : Right;
  const made: Left | Right = new Constructor();
  console.log(made);
  const Shape = flag ? Point : Scaled;
  console.log(new Shape(3));
  console.log(new (flag ? Generic : Point)(4));
}
